entries.cannot_check_condition: No systematic full-text novelty search or external specialist review is available.
entries.diagnosis: The deterministic vector recursion is the static-state finite-horizon POMDP policy-tree/alpha-vector construction; robust scalarization is finite minimax decision theory, and robust POMDP work is a direct neighbor.
entries.negative_condition: The claim reduces to policy-tree vector enumeration plus support-function minimization.
entries.next_discriminator: Prove a result unavailable from Smallwood-Sondik plus standard minimax, such as an exact nonrectangular dynamic-consistency characterization, credal-specific frontier complexity bound, or misspecified-kernel coverage theorem.
entries.positive_condition: A formal reduction shows the donor product cannot derive the claimed residual and a theorem with a proof survives expert literature review.
entries.predecessor_claim: The risk-vector Bellman frontier could be presented as a new theorem-level contribution.
entries.successor_identity: A genuinely new theorem beyond alpha-vector enumeration and finite zero-sum convexification.

entries.cannot_check_condition: Operational availability/transition semantics are not frozen.
entries.corrected_statement: For a finite controlled experimental state s, define Gamma_{n,s} using only e in E(s), state-dependent c(s,e), K(o,s_next|s,e,w), and continuation vectors in Gamma_{n-1,s_next}. The displayed Gamma_n theorem applies only to the stationary always-available model.
entries.diagnosis: The displayed recursion uses the same E and K_e at every node. A controlled experimental state needs state-indexed action sets, kernels, costs, and a state transition; augmenting a label without changing the recursion does not enforce legality.
entries.negative_condition: A legal restriction is only described in prose while the recurrence still admits an unavailable test.
entries.next_discriminator: State and prove the controlled-state recursion and verify a destructive-test example against exhaustive policy enumeration.
entries.positive_condition: The state-indexed recursion equals exhaustive legal policy-tree risks.
entries.predecessor_claim: History-dependent availability/no-repeat restrictions are represented merely by placing state in W or policy state while retaining the displayed stationary Gamma recursion.
entries.successor_identity: State-indexed active-identification frontiers for destructive, replenishing, or no-repeat experiments.

entries.cannot_check_condition: The operational credal registry is not frozen.
entries.corrected_statement: The robust value uses sup_{p in Pi}; an optimizing policy is attained on the finite/convex policy frontier, but a worst-case licensed prior need not exist unless additional compactness is imposed.
entries.diagnosis: Theorem 3 correctly uses a supremum and proves policy attainment only. Nature/prior attainment can fail when Pi is not closed.
entries.negative_condition: A report names a worst-case prior for an open Pi without an attainment proof.
entries.next_discriminator: Require Pi compact or report epsilon-worst priors without calling one least favourable.
entries.positive_condition: Pi is closed in the finite simplex, hence compact, and the linear risk functional attains its supremum.
entries.predecessor_claim: An arbitrary nonclosed credal set supplies an attained worst-case prior.
entries.successor_identity: Approximate least-favourable-prior certificates for open credal sets.

entries.cannot_check_condition: The P3/P5 protocol has not declared fixed-prior versus rectangular semantics.
entries.diagnosis: N5 correctly refutes this. The fixed ex-ante prior set and rectangular historywise ambiguity are different games; a policy protocol must license one nature move.
entries.negative_condition: Independent posterior worst cases are selected under a fixed nonrectangular prior registry.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze the nature protocol and verify whether every historywise posterior splice corresponds to one licensed ex-ante prior.
entries.positive_condition: The ambiguity set is explicitly rectangular or the vector frontier is scalarized only at the root.
entries.predecessor_claim: The ex-ante nonrectangular robust value is interchangeable with posterior-local minimax control.
entries.smallest_counterexample: Retained source witness N5: two priors on (Z,Y), ex-ante minimax error 0.1 versus posterior-rectangular error 0.5.
entries.successor_identity: Dynamic provenance and rectangularity audit for licensed ambiguity.

entries.corrected_statement: Report deterministic and randomized robust values separately unless the protocol licenses an auditable random seed and randomized terminal action.
entries.diagnosis: Mathematically, behavioral randomization gives conv(Gamma_n) under world-independent randomization and perfect recall. Operationally, random terminal scientific claims or revisions may be inadmissible or unauditable.
entries.negative_condition: A convexified theoretical comparator is reported as an executable scientific authority.
entries.next_discriminator: Specify seed custody, decoder access, repeatability, and whether deferral dominates random proclamation.
entries.positive_condition: Behavioral randomization is world-independent, uses perfect recall, and is operationally licensed.
entries.predecessor_claim: The convexified robust value is automatically an admissible scientific decision procedure.
entries.smallest_counterexample: Retained source witness N6: two point-mass worlds, deterministic minimax error 1, fair randomized error 1/2.

entries.corrected_statement: Keep the positive-cost assumption in every statement. For zero-cost acquisitions use a separate test-count/resource vector, or quotient out the zero-cost closure before applying a positive-cost bound.
entries.diagnosis: Theorem 4 explicitly requires c_e>0. The base model allows c_e=0, where KL/c is undefined or infinite and no positive cost lower bound follows.
entries.negative_condition: A positive cost obligation is inferred when a zero-cost separating path exists.
entries.next_discriminator: Define a strictly positive resource gauge or characterize the zero-cost reachability closure first.
entries.positive_condition: Every available informative test has a declared strictly positive charged resource.
entries.predecessor_claim: The information-cost lower bound covers zero-cost tests.
entries.successor_identity: Multi-resource lower bounds with free preprocessing/tests.

entries.negative_condition: Only the standard oriented pairwise KL obligation is proved.

entries.positive_condition: A new class-level allocation theorem has matching upper and lower bounds.

entries.successor_identity: Composite-target achievability/exponent theory beyond pairwise necessity.

entries.corrected_statement: Describe Theorem 4 as a necessary oriented pairwise obligation with no achievability claim.
entries.diagnosis: They are necessary only. They neither prove simultaneous achievability nor specify the optimal allocation across all cross-target pairs.

entries.positive_condition: A matching upper bound holds uniformly over each composite target class.
entries.predecessor_claim: Pairwise lower bounds characterize the composite-target optimum.
entries.successor_identity: Target-class Chernoff allocation and matching error exponents.

entries.corrected_statement: All displayed results remain finite-horizon and finite-alphabet; the standard-Borel/infinite-horizon program is open.
entries.diagnosis: Finite transcript support arguments avoid measurable partitions, regular conditional probabilities, measurable selection, and infinite-horizon existence issues.

entries.cannot_check_condition: No operational invalid-history route is defined.
entries.corrected_statement: Zero-denominator histories terminate the licensed model and cannot be assigned an envelope or posterior without a separately authorized model-expansion rule.
entries.diagnosis: The packet correctly declares such a history invalid; it supplies no recovery policy for model/interface falsification.
entries.negative_condition: An arbitrary posterior is used to make a scientific claim after a globally impossible history.
entries.next_discriminator: Specify a model-expansion/contamination protocol whose new prior mass and authority are independently licensed.
entries.positive_condition: The history has positive probability under at least one licensed prior, or an explicit recovery model is invoked.
entries.predecessor_claim: Conditioning and Bellman policies remain scientifically valid when an observed history has zero likelihood under every licensed prior.
